model.trainedOn: 160,000 synthetic Brahmi lines (Noto Sans Brahmi, Maataa Lipi Brahmi), then fine-tuned 3 epochs on 160,000 lines mixing those with Kushan head marks and later shapes drawn from Siddham, Bhaiksuki, Sharada, Nandinagari, Grantha and Kawi fonts, labelled in Brahmi

lumbini.source: Rummindei pillar inscription, reading after E. Hultzsch, Inscriptions of Asoka (1925)
